title.es: Ensayo de opinión: móviles en clase

es: Escribir y defender un ensayo breve de opinión sobre los móviles en clase con introducción, dos razones, contraargumento con réplica y conclusión.

prompt.es: Escribe un ensayo breve: tesis, dos razones, contraargumento con réplica y conclusión.

answer.text: I believe that phones should stay in bags during lessons. First, phones distract students. In a school survey, 40 of 60 students said that they look at their phones in class without permission. Moreover, a clear policy helps teachers, seeing that they do not have to stop the lesson every time a phone rings. Critics say that a phone is useful in an emergency. I admit that this is a valid point. However, the school office can call the parents quickly, so students do not need a phone in the classroom. Overall, the benefit is small compared with the distraction, so the school should keep the policy.
accepted: I believe that phones should stay in bags during lessons. First, phones distract students. In a school survey, 40 of 60 students said that they look at their phones in class without permission. Moreover, a clear policy helps teachers, seeing that they do not have to stop the lesson every time a phone rings. Critics say that a phone is useful in an emergency. I admit that this is a valid point. However, the school office can call the parents quickly, so students do not need a phone in the classroom. Overall, the benefit is small compared with the distraction, so the school should keep the policy.

In my view, phones should stay in bags during lessons. The first reason is that phones distract students. According to a school survey, 40 of 60 students look at their phones in class without permission. Moreover, a clear policy helps teachers because they do not have to stop the lesson. Some people say that a phone is useful in an emergency. It is true that this can happen. Nevertheless, the school office can call the parents quickly, so a phone in the classroom is not necessary. Overall, the benefit is small compared with the distraction, and therefore the school should keep the policy.

feedback.es: Un ensayo completo tiene tesis clara, dos razones con dato, un contraargumento con concesión y réplica, y una conclusión que repite la tesis.

origin.text: Tema: ¿deben los móviles quedarse en la mochila durante las clases? Datos: en una encuesta del colegio, 40 de 60 estudiantes dicen que miran el móvil en clase sin permiso. Una norma clara evita que los profesores tengan que parar la clase. Los críticos dicen que el móvil es útil en una emergencia; réplica: la secretaría del colegio puede llamar rápido a los padres.

prompt.es: ¿Qué fallo tiene esta réplica de un compañero?

choices.text: It takes one case as a general rule.
It mixes up a coincidence and a cause.
It attacks Tom instead of his idea.

feedback.es: El compañero descarta la opinión de Tom por llegar siempre tarde, en lugar de responder a lo que dice sobre los móviles: es un ataque personal.

origin.text: Tom says phones are fine. But Tom is always late, so his opinion does not count.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué prueba da la persona.

choices.text: A school survey in which most students admit it.
A story about one student and his phone.
The opinion of one famous teacher.

feedback.es: La persona responde con una encuesta del colegio: un dato de muchos estudiantes, no un caso aislado ni una opinión.

origin.audio: I wrote that phones should stay in bags on the grounds that they distract students. A teacher asked for evidence. I said that in a school survey, most students admitted looking at their phones during lessons.

prompt.es: Completa cada frase con el conector de fundamento o de réplica.

accepted: In view of | insofar as | however

feedback.es: In view of va con un sustantivo; insofar as limita la utilidad a una condición; however abre la réplica.

answer.text: I admit that some students use phones well. However, a rule that is the same for everyone is fair.
accepted: I admit that some students use phones well. However, a rule that is the same for everyone is fair.
It is true that some students use phones well. Nevertheless, a rule that is the same for everyone is fair.

feedback.es: Una buena defensa reconoce lo válido (I admit) y responde con una razón (a rule for everyone is fair), sin atacar a quien pregunta.

origin.text: Objection: Is it fair that every student follows the same rule because of a few students?

answer.text: A good essay ends with a clear conclusion
